schema_kind: Conceptual field and invariant specification; not a runtime implementation or instantiated trace; no actual query, answer or gold records

envelope_fields.generation_model: resolved model/version and settings; unknown provenance explicit
envelope_fields.production_repeat_id: opaque schedule slot, no difficulty encoding
envelope_fields.original_query: exact query bytes/string, never overwritten by normalization
envelope_fields.runtime_normalized_query: string if normalization occurs, preserve original separately
envelope_fields.sealed_at_utc: timestamp or null if not sealed
envelope_fields.aspect_snapshots: immutable AspectSnapshot[] if candidate abstraction authorized
envelope_fields.production_seal: external manifest hashes every final output and raw trace; no circular self-hash

StageEvent.occurrence: positive integer; never overwrite first occurrence
StageEvent.status: completed | skipped | not_reached | failed; null is not false
StageEvent.started_at: timestamp or null when not reached
StageEvent.raw_output: exact stage payload in file or inline immutable bytes; no hidden chain of thought required
StageEvent.parsed_output: validated decision data; preserve even when later superseded
StageEvent.reason: concise decision rationale, not private reasoning transcript
StageEvent.call_ids: retrieval or production IDs; empty for local stages

query_received.preserve: original query bytes/hash and opaque ID

initial_retrieval.preserve: initial candidates, ranks, initial_top5 and retrieval call

aspect_identification.when: With query/coverage; abstraction conditional on R3 authorization
aspect_identification.preserve: detected aspects and origins; stage may share existing call, no extra budget

subqueries.preserve: exact subquery strings, target aspects, informational differences; no examples in design

expansion_retrieval.when: Per executed subquery within one episode
expansion_retrieval.preserve: expansion evidence snapshots, calls, failure/early-stop records

evidence_merge.preserve: merged candidate snapshot, dedup identity, merge-rerank operation

final_evidence_selection.preserve: final_top5 snapshot; preserve initial and all expansion snapshots

applicability_assessment_final.preserve: updated support/applicability, lost evidence and unresolved aspects

completeness_check_1.preserve: CompletenessPayload bound to draft; never overwrite

revision_decision.preserve: DecisionPayload with specific admissible targets and remaining budget

answer_revision.preserve: immutable revised AnswerVersion or failure; draft retained

completeness_check_2.when: After revised answer; explicitly skipped if no revision
completeness_check_2.preserve: separate CompletenessPayload bound to revised version

citation_check.preserve: CitationPayload with syntax and semantic distinction

citation_edit.when: If separately allowed under reference budget
citation_edit.preserve: new answer version; optional branch, not proposed new mechanism

post_edit_verification.preserve: necessary current-version checks or explicit unverified state; no automatic budget increase

finalization.preserve: Finalization with status, unresolved aspects, costs and references

EvidenceSnapshot.citation_map: evidence ID to chunk/content hash; stable run-local IDs, preserve each map

EvidenceItem.evidence_id: stable run-local ID, never recycled for different content
EvidenceItem.text: exact text supplied or immutable reconstructable content reference
EvidenceItem.retrieval_call_ids: IDs of calls contributing this item
EvidenceItem.ranks_scores: per-stage rank/score with scorer identity, not directly comparable across different scorers

AspectSnapshot.aspects: Aspect[] including candidate and terminal references

Aspect.aspect_id: stable runtime ID; never evaluator gold ID
Aspect.origin_query_spans: offset/span references for explicit origin or intent link
Aspect.inference_rationale: concise rationale and parent IDs for inferred origin
Aspect.answer_disposition: pending | answered_supported | answered_qualified | unresolved_disclosed | unresolved_undisclosed | excluded_with_reason | merged_into
Aspect.answer_spans: answer version ID plus offsets; cannot refer to a stale answer as final
Aspect.unresolved_reason: evidence_missing | applicability_unknown | evidence_conflict | supported_omission | budget | outside_scope | other with rationale

AspectEvent.event_type: identified | searched | support_assessed | applicability_assessed | promoted | demoted | merged | support_lost | answered | unresolved | excluded | reopened
AspectEvent.before: prior state reference or null only for identified
AspectEvent.supporting_refs: query spans, evidence, answer or prior event IDs

CompletenessPayload.supported_omission_aspect_ids: runtime IDs with supporting evidence links
CompletenessPayload.unresolved_disclosure_refs: aspect IDs plus answer spans or missing flags
CompletenessPayload.internal_full_complete: boolean or null if unassessed; no gold certification

ExpansionValueAccounting.assessment_source: runtime_estimate; independent evaluator version stored externally after sealing
ExpansionValueAccounting.subquery_refs: exact strings stored in subquery stage, source aspect IDs and informational difference rationale
ExpansionValueAccounting.new_unique_chunks: IDs and count relative to previous candidate pool
ExpansionValueAccounting.newly_resolved_aspects: IDs previously not sufficient now sufficiently supported with applicable evidence
ExpansionValueAccounting.condition_clarifications: IDs plus justified refinement of uncertainty
ExpansionValueAccounting.final_topk_changed: ordered-list comparison and set comparison booleans
ExpansionValueAccounting.no_demonstrated_value: boolean or null with reason; novel chunks alone not value
ExpansionValueAccounting.retrieval_cost: call IDs, merge IDs, attempts, wall time, known tokens where relevant

AnswerVersion.answer_text: exact generated text; no example instantiated here
AnswerVersion.claim_change_summary: added/removed/changed claim spans; runtime estimates, not gold labels
AnswerVersion.selected_final_reference: reference existing immutable version rather than overwrite

CitationPayload.method: deterministic syntax / semantic method ID; cannot equate syntax to entailment
CitationPayload.cited_claim_refs: claim spans and attached evidence IDs

RetrievalCall.retrieval_round: nonnegative index, reference cap one expansion episode
RetrievalCall.candidate_result_snapshot_id: snapshot ID or null on failure

ProductionLLMCall.purpose: coverage | generation | completeness | revision | citation_review_or_repair; no evaluator stages
ProductionLLMCall.request_payload_ref: exact prompt/input payload and hash; exclude credentials
ProductionLLMCall.response_payload_ref: raw response and hash or null on failure
ProductionLLMCall.retry_reason: predeclared transport rule only, never quality
ProductionLLMCall.accepted_attempt_id: first valid permitted attempt or null

Finalization.final_answer_version_id: selected immutable answer ID or null on error
Finalization.last_completeness_event_id: current final check ID or null
Finalization.last_citation_event_id: current final check ID or null
Finalization.final_status: success_complete | success_partial_with_disclosure | insufficient_evidence | incomplete_answer | citation_failure | verification_incomplete | runtime_error
Finalization.stop_reason: scope_addressed | evidence_limit | no_value_expansion | budget_exhausted | unsearchable_gap | execution_failure
Finalization.unresolved_aspect_ids: all explicit/admitted unresolved IDs with disclosure refs
Finalization.excluded_candidate_refs: terminal audit entries, not required answer content
Finalization.secondary_failure_flags: retain all known failures even if priority outcome masks them
Finalization.totals: logical retrieval/merge/production LLM calls, physical attempts, tokens, latency with unknowns

invariants: Every emitted stage is immutable and sequence ordered; event refs resolve; raw and parsed first completeness payloads survive all later checks.
Skipped/not_reached branches have explicit records and reasons; missing payloads are not empty successful checks.
Every answer/evidence/check snapshot has a stable ID and content hash; full stage reconstruction is possible from retained bytes and refs.
Revision stages reference draft and revised versions separately; final checks bind exact selected-final bytes.
Citation edit creates a new answer version; a stale completeness or semantic citation check cannot certify it. If budget cannot support necessary checks, use verification_incomplete.
Aspect identities persist across every later expected snapshot or resolve through an explicit merge/exclusion event; origin history is never lost.
Inferred candidates require evidence, defensible applicability and direct intent before admission; unsupported candidates do not create answer obligations.
An explicit unsupported ask persists as a disclosure obligation; runtime not_found_in_available_evidence is not corpus-wide absence.
Budget ceilings do not increase to accommodate schema fields; all attempted and failed calls are counted, evaluator calls excluded.
No gold, evaluator labels, TEST difficulty, reference answers or historical results enter production; evaluator enrichment stored in a separate post-seal namespace.
Production logs contain concise observable decisions and raw stage outputs, not credentials or demanded hidden chain of thought.
No runtime status is benchmark-certified; all secondary error/unresolved flags retained.

evaluator_side_join_design.timing: only after all planned production outputs sealed
evaluator_side_join_design.storage: separate evaluator-only namespace, never mutate production trace

historical_reference_budgets.note: Read-only historical source references, not proposed new code paths. Budget increases are UNTESTED DESIGN OPTION.
